title: populus nigra subsp. pyramidalis
intro: Populus nigra subsp. pyramidalis, commonly known as Black Poplar, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Black Poplar include its analgesic and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain and fever relief. The bioactive constituents of Black Poplar include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
